title: Do not use a previous click position for a scroll ripple.
comment:
**Do not use a previous click position for a scroll ripple.**

After a click, `action_pos` remains set. A later `Scroll` increments `action_seq` without changing that position, and this condition permits another ripple. The scroll therefore draws a ripple at the old click, even if the scroll occurs on another monitor. Limit position-based ripples to actions that record their own coordinates, or report a fresh scroll position.
